fieldNotes.siteResolution: NOT FOUND / UNDER CONSTRUCTION. Web research firmly establishes the facility: Primo Brands broke ground on a new ~200,000 sq ft Mountain Valley factory (production + logistics + warehouse, one small-format + two large-format lines) on Glazypeau Road near Hot Springs Village, Garland County AR on Oct 29 2025; fully operational targeted spring 2026 (Hot Springs Sentinel-Record, Talk Business, Arkansas EDC, prnewswire). No public source gives a street number or parcel. Distinct from the legacy idx-29 Mountain Valley plant at 283 Mountain Valley Water Pl. Satellite swept along the full Glazypeau Rd corridor at z16-z18 (E Glazypeau Rd / Hwy 7 junction ~34.626-34.633, -93.056 to -93.062, plus the given point 34.6100,-93.0500 which is rural forest). The corridor imagery shows only pre-existing uses: self-storage rows, flea-market/storage sheds, a school/church campus, scattered rural commercial, ponds/old quarry pads, and large open pasture fields. NO 200k sqft factory building and NO large-scale active construction (graded building pad, foundations, crane/laydown yard) is visible in any tile. Google satellite vintage clearly predates the Oct 2025 groundbreaking, and Street View along the corridor dates to 2023-02/2023-12. The exact parcel cannot be confirmed from current imagery.
